summary: Implemented every stub in defaults.py (already complete), nodes.py (Node traversal and find helpers, set_ctx, set_lineno, set_environment, expression as_const folding and can_assign, Const.from_untrusted, _failing_new, and the restored get_eval_context helper and subclass as_const methods), optimizer.py (optimize and constant-folding Optimizer.generic_visit), and utils.py (pass decorators, LRUCache, urlize, lorem ipsum, import_string, select_autoescape and the other helpers, plus the restored _PassArg.from_obj). The last full-suite run I saw was 848 passed and 3 failed, and those 3 failures are in files I do not own: filters do_indent trailing newline, a PermissionError in test_loader, and async_utils wrapper pickling.
